title: Green synthesis of new chiral amino acid urea derivatives and evaluation of their anti-inflammatory activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36219-36229
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04473A, Paper

Sirine Mehrez, Sarah Absi, Assia Hamdi, Sylvain Marque, Abderrahman Bouraoui, Yakdhane Kacem, Jamil Kraiem
Green synthesis of new chiral amino acid urea derivatives in high yields. The in silico study showed interesting anti-inflammatory activities and acceptable values of drug-likeness. The in vivo results are in good agreement with the molecular docking analysis.
